Module 1: High-Ticket Positioning & Value-Based Pricing Architecture

01_Positioning_Packaging_and_Pricing_Engine.md * The Value-Based Math Model: Step-by-step algorithms and ROI formulas to price projects based on commercial impact ($10k–$50k+) rather than arbitrary hourly estimates. * Productized Service Tiering Matrix: Turn custom technical chaos into 3 distinct, packaged tiers (Audits, Sprints, and Full-Scale Deployments) that eliminate price shopping. * Frictionless Discovery Call Script: Word-for-word conversational framework to unearth executive pain points, determine budget thresholds, and disqualify bad-fit clients within 20 minutes. * The "Hourly-to-Value" Bridge: Tactical client-facing scripts to seamlessly transition existing low-rate clients into fixed-scope or value-anchored engagements without friction.

Module 2: 25+ High-Converting Proposals, Pitch Decks & Scope Decks

02_Winning_Proposals_and_Pitch_Decks.md * 70%+ Close-Rate Proposal Blueprints: Modular, executive-ready proposal structures covering Full-Stack Web Apps, Cloud Migrations, Mobile Builds, and Fractional CTO engagements. * Async Pitch Deck & Loom Scripts: 5-minute video walkthrough frameworks that close high-ticket stakeholders asynchronously before you even jump on a second call. * The 3-Option Proposal Architecture: Strategic structuring that anchors high-tier pricing and nudges clients toward your target mid-tier package 8 times out of 10. * Technical Scope Decks: Pre-built slide templates to communicate technical complexity, project risks, sprint cadences, and milestones cleanly to non-technical executives.

Module 3: Attorney-Vetted Contracts, MSAs, SOWs & Change Order Systems

03_Ironclad_Contracts_MSAs_and_SOW_Vault.md * Master Services Agreement (MSA): Comprehensive, attorney-reviewed terms covering IP assignment upon final payment, liability caps, warranties, and confidential information covenants. * Modular Statement of Work (SOW): Bulletproof scoping framework with strict sprint definitions, sign-off milestones, and acceptance test criteria. * Scope-Creep Protection Protocol & Change Order Form: Legally sound, non-confrontational change order workflows to bill extra for out-of-scope requests without client friction. * Aggressive Payment Terms: Net-15 clauses, upfront milestone deposits (50/25/25), late-fee escalation formulas, and work-stoppage triggers for late payments.

04_Client_Onboarding_Portals_and_Retainer_Playbooks.md * Plug-and-Play Notion Client Portal: Complete project management dashboard schema featuring milestone trackers, asset vaults, meeting note hubs, and shared sign-off docs. * Automated Welcome Sequences: Pre-written onboarding email cadences, technical intake questionnaires, and environment access checklists (AWS, GitHub, API keys). * The "Project-to-Retainer" Transition Playbook: Closing scripts and SLA frameworks to convert one-off development builds into $3k–$8k/month recurring advisory and maintenance retainers. * Late-Payment Dunning Sequences: 4 escalating, polite-yet-uncompromising email templates designed to collect overdue invoices immediately while preserving the relationship.
